Features

Everything you need to invest smarter, together.

StockBud brings your portfolio, your friends, and the markets into one place.

🏆

Climb the Leaderboard

Compete on public leaderboards or create private leagues. See how your portfolio stacks up week-on-week against real investors.

💬

Join the Conversation

Follow investors, share ideas, and see what people are actually doing with their portfolios. The social feed built for money talk.

📈

Track Your Portfolio

Link your existing brokerage and get real-time performance analytics, live charts, and market data in one clean view.

🚪

Private Rooms

Create or join rooms with friends, course mates, or your investment society. Private leagues, shared conversations, real competition.

How It Works

Up and running in minutes.

1

Download

Get StockBud free from the App Store. Free on iOS. No trading, just tracking, competing, and learning.

2

Link Your Portfolio

Connect your Trading 212 account. StockBud pulls your real holdings — read only, no trading, just tracking.

3

Compete

Join the UoM leaderboard, enter private leagues, and see where you rank. Best portfolio performance wins.

🎓 UoM Students

UoM Competition — Open Now

Sign up with your student email and head to the Compete tab to enter. Track your real portfolio performance against other UoM students and see where you rank.
